subject: general
question:
Tufail walks 100 m towards the north. From there, he turns right and walks 220 m. Again, he turns right and walks 121 m. In which direction is he with reference to his starting point?

(Note: All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
**Given:**

Tufail walks 100 m towards the north.

Then he turns right and walks 220 m.

Again, he turns right and walks 121 m.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81ddeb128671dc963f4dbaaa5d72a441aa544d7d618c7cef3b63e2aa9259313d.png] 

 

So, from the starting point, Tufail is towards the **Southeast** direction.

**Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".**
